tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// srid pa gter khyim gyi rgyun gsol mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

'bod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// sku yi gnas brgyad nas sprul pa'i// dregs pa sde brgyad pho mo klu| |phyi nang gsang sbas bstan skyong dang*// drag sngags btags chags ma chags dang*// las byed bstan srung sde brgyad tshogs// 'khor bcas ma thogs deng 'bod kyi// rgyug cing mchong zhing dam la 'dus// 'dir gshegs mthun pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dgyes pa'i rten la gnas chos shig |e tri ma phu sa ma ya dzaḥ hrīṃ tiṣṭha lhan/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ e ya/ nga ni phyag rgya zil gyis gnon// 'jam dpal khros pa chen po'i sku/ */dam tshig 'bog pa'i sku can de// dregs pa sde brgyad dam tshig mno// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas// sde brgyad dregs pa gzir ba'i tshe// bsgral gyi dogs pas khyod 'jigs nas// srog snying phul nas khas blangs pa// ji lta de ltar deng bdag gis// dbang du bsdus nas dam tshig sbyin// tshul bzhin mnos la srung bar gyis// dam dang ldan na srung ma'i mchog /dam las 'gal na bsgral ba'i zhing*// de ltar soms la las sgrubs shig /sa ma ya na rakkan/ zhes sam/ sde brgyad rnams kyi mgor rdo rje dang*/ lce la bdud rtsi bzhag /mchod pa ni/ hoḥ snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad la// thun mchog rigs kyi dam rdzas 'bul// zhe sdang las kyi dregs pa can// pho rgyud tshogs rnams chang gis mchod// 'dod chags las kyi dregs pa can// mo rgyud tshogs rnams khrag gis mchod// gti mug las kyi dregs pa can// klu rgyud tshogs rnams sman gyis mchod// gzhan yang 'thung ba'i dam rdzas ni// 'chi med pañtsa a mṛ ta// dmar chen rakta'i lbu phreng g.yo// dug gsum gtor ma ri ltar brjid// zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// mgo lus dbang po nang khrol bcas// mchog chen mchog phran la sogs pa// sde brgyad rang rang yid mthun pa'i// rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas// dam rdzas bskang rdzas gzir ba'i rdzas// mnan rdzas sreg rdzas 'phang ba'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa'i dkor nor gyis// phyi yi sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// nang gi sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// sbas pa'i sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// bstan skyong sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// drags sngags sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// btags chags sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// ma chags sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// las byed sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// bstan srung sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// pho rgyud sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// mo rgyud sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// klu rgyud sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// gnyug mar gnas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// glo bur lhags pa'i thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo gsol lo dgyes par mdzod// dgyes bzhin bcol ba'i las sgrubs shig

|bshags pa ni/ hoḥ mthu chen las la grub pa'i sde brgyad tshogs// sngags 'chang bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// mchod gtor ma tshang chung dang 'bags shing btsog /chad lhag nor 'khrul dregs pa'i thugs dang 'gal// nongs gyur gang bgyis bshags so bzod par gsol// bzod par gsol yang tshangs par mi mdzad na// sde brgyad 'joms pa'i dpal chen rab khros pa'i// dam tshig rdo rje ye shes me 'bar bas// nyams pa'i mgo lus 'gems par cis mi 'gyur// de bas tshangs pa'i 'bras bu dgyes par mdzod// ces dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bstod pa ni/ e/ sngon tshe zhe sdang drag po'i dbang gyur pas// smon lam log par btab pas da lta'i tshe// lus ngag yid gsum zhe sdang me ltar 'bar// nga rgyal khro gtum che bas lus rgyas shing*// 'jigs rngam mi sdug kha rlangs dri chu las// mi bzad gdug pa'i sna tshogs nad 'ong zhing*// kha nas ngan sngags gleng bas gzhan srog 'phrog /lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs// sra ba'i go gyon lus kyi ba spu yang*// mtshon char skyes pa'i sha khrag zas su rol// srog gcod la rngams gzhan pas tshe ring zhing*// sna tshogs sprul bsgyur mthu stobs drag shul can// sde brgyad dregs pa rnams la bdag bstod do// brgya byin thags bzang ris dang dga' bo dang*// bya rog mgo brtsegs dang ni tshangs pa dang*// laṅka mgrin bcu bdud rgyal dmu rje btsan// phyi yi sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// klu rgyal sog ma med dang tsa muṇḍi// gshin rje dmar po gza' bdud btsan bdud nag /gser mig yul lha de wa 'brug sgrog sman// nang gi sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// ma hā de wa 'chi bdag mgo dgu pa// gshin rje chos rgyal e ka tsa ti dang*// rol pa skya gcig raksha nag po dang*| |lo ka rā tsa khyab 'jug chen po ste// gsang ba'i sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// bi nā ya ka dmu bdud hā li ka// mu kha le dang srin po raksha nag */gsod byed ma dang rol po glog 'khyug dang*// yaksha kā lā bya rog mgo brtsegs te// sbas pa'i sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// yab rje nag po dkar po snying 'byin dang*// yul lha phya sang dpal mgon nag po dang*// rdor legs srin po srog bdag gnam the'u dkar// yam shud dmar po ma mo re ma ti// bstan skyong sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// sbrul mgo can btsan dmu rje ya ba ti// bdud nag bkrag med srin po srog gcod nag

/sbrul zhags can klu gnod sbyin srog gcod ma// ma mo nag mo khrag 'dzag ma dang bcas// drag sngags sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// rang rang yul dang mkhar dang gnas dang rten// ming dang brda la btags shing chags pa yi// pho mo klu rgyud gsum gyis rab bsdus pa// btags chags sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// gnyan chen thang lha g.ya' spang skyes gcig dang*// the'u klung btsan baṃ chen ru tra dang*// he le 'bar ma zur phud can dang ni// rgyal po shing bya bya rong pa til dang*// gzhan yang 'o de gung rgyal la sogs pa// lha rgyud sum brgya drug cu ma btags shing*// ma chags sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// 'chi bdag gshin rje ma mo bdud dang btsan// rgyal po klu dang gnod sbyin gza' bdud sogs// las byed myur mgyogs rtsal ldan dregs pa'i sde// bstan srung sde brgyad rnams la bdag bstod do// khyod rnams sngon tshe gcig la gcig 'tshe bas// nor bral bu dang chung ma pha ma dang*// gnyen bshes rnams bsad yul phyung mig brus shing*// sgyid pa breg sogs ma len chad pa dang*// mang po kha 'dus bsad tshe mi sdug pa'i// smon lam log par btab tshe mi sdug pa'i// lha 'dre dregs pa can du rab skyes nas// bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod rnams dam btag tshe// skrag cing bred du bcug pa ma gtogs pa// bsgral bar ma nus las dbang btsan par dgongs// de lta'i dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs la bstod// dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma mthun pa'i rdzas// bzhes la bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ oṃ ya mānta ka shrī he ru ka ga ru ḍa e tri ma phu tsitta dza dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ sa ma ya dam la 'dus 'dus/ zhes ci nus bzla/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor bsngos byas la/ hūm̐ e/ nga ni ya mānta ka ste// che mchog rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /khyung chen la sogs nga yi dngos// snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad kyang*// gshin rje'i gshed po'i gnas brgyad nas// sprul zhing byung ba nga nyid de// de bas rang snang rang rtsal las// byung ba'i dregs pa pho mo klu// gsum gyis bsdus pa'i tshogs rnams kun| |bos pa'i tshe na dam la 'dus// rbad pa'i tshe na las la rgyugs// bskul ba'i tshe na ngag la nyon// bcol ba'i tshe na las kun sgrubs// rang rang mthun pa'i rten 'di la// dgyes bzhin rtag tu 'khor ba dang*// brtan par bzhugs la mchod gtor bzhes// sman raka skyems la ngom par rol// pho rgyud tshogs rnams myos byed dang*// mo rgyud tshogs rnams dmar chen khrag

/klu rgyud tshogs rnams dkar gtor sman// rang rang mthun rdzas dgyes par rol// dga' mgu tshim zhing rol pa dang*// rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa yis// sngags 'chang bdag gi las sgrubs shig /dregs pa dam las ma 'da' bar// bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' ste// dregs pa mchod cing tshim par bgyid// de bas zhi rgyas dbang drag po'i// phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma phul lo// de ltar dregs pa'i phrin las kyang*// mdor bsdus yin gyi las sbyar sogs// gal che'i dus su gter khyim gyi// phrin las logs su yod ltar spyad// don la ye shes 'jig rten pa// kun kyang rang sems las gzhan pa// med par rtogs na dregs pas kyang*/ mchog gi dngos grub stsol bar nus// bdag dang gzhan zhes tha dad par// gnyis 'dzin don dam la byas na| |thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la sogs// rnams kyis thun mong stsol ba'ang dka'// de phyir don dam gnas lugs kyi// rang bzhin rtogs pa kun la gces// de skad 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung*// dus mtha'i sngags 'chang chos grags kyis// smras so kun dang mthun yang legs// min yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang ni// bslu med rgyu 'bras dang mthun na// kun dang 'gal yang 'gyod pa bral// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
